issues.description: The solution implementation uses a display buffer size that contradicts the problem statement and the template. The problem statement and the template expect a 1920 × 1080 framebuffer (template: display_start RESB 8294400), and the solution's addressing arithmetic assumes a width of 1920 (multiplication by 7680 = 1920*4). However, the solution reserves only 409600 bytes for display_start and comments that only 320×320 is reserved. This mismatch between the allocated buffer size and the code's assumed resolution can lead to out-of-bounds accesses, runtime errors, and confusion about which resolution students should target.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the solution consistent with the problem/template resolution. Either (A) change the solution's display_start allocation to reserve 1920×1080×4 = 8294400 bytes (e.g. display_start RESB 8294400) and update/remove the "Only 320x320 reserved" comment, or (B) if the solution is intended to use 320×320, change all addressing arithmetic constants (and update the problem description and template) to match 320×320. Preferred: update the solution to allocate 8294400 bytes so it matches the problem statement and template.
